About Me

I am a research engineer in the R&D department at OLM Digital in Tokyo.

I obtained my PhD in 2024 at INRIA/University of Bordeaux under the supervision of Pascal Barla and Pierre Bénard. During my PhD, my research focused on computer-assisted traditional 2D animation, more specifically on developing new methods to design and explore motion from rough key drawings. More details can be found here or in the publication page.

During my Master’s degree, I worked on geometric deformation for 3D animation with Camille Brunel.

I am interested in all aspects of computer graphics, in particular 2D/3D animation and NPR, where I can work alongside artists to provide them with new innovative tools and creative freedom.
